_Private · Encrypted · Offline by design_

# Your records never leave the room.

Aveneg Technologies, LLC builds private, encrypted desktop software for people who keep a careful record of something valuable, held entirely on your own computer. No cloud, no account, and no company holding a copy of what you own.

_What we build_

## Software for people who collect.

Watch Vault Archive is the first — encrypted, offline, built around provenance and long-term record-keeping rather than a feed. The same architecture is built to serve other collector communities the same way, as they come.

### Watch Vault Archive

An encrypted, offline desktop application for cataloguing a watch collection — appraisals, service history, provenance and succession, held entirely on your own computer.

_About_

# A software company built around one idea.

Most software today assumes your data belongs somewhere else — on a server you don't control, tied to an account you can't close, held by a company that can be breached, acquired, or shut down without your say. We started Aveneg Technologies, LLC to build the opposite: software that keeps sensitive, valuable records exactly where their owner put them, and nowhere else.

_Philosophy_

## Why offline, why encrypted.

A record of something valuable — a collection, its provenance, its appraisals — is worth protecting like the thing itself. Keeping that record in the cloud multiplies the ways it can be exposed: a provider's breach, a subpoena served on a company instead of a person, a service that quietly shuts down and takes years of entries with it. Offline software removes those risks by removing the server. There is no account to compromise and no copy sitting anywhere but the owner's own computer.

Encryption is the other half of it. Every application we build encrypts its data at rest by default, with a key only its owner holds. We can't read it, recover it, or hand it to anyone who asks — because we never have it in the first place.

_What we publish_

## One product, built to be the first of several.

### Watch Vault Archive

An encrypted, offline desktop application for cataloguing a watch collection — appraisals, service history, provenance and succession, held entirely on the owner's own computer. The same architecture — private, encrypted, offline by design — is built to serve other collector communities the same way, as they come.

[watchvaultarchive.com →](https://watchvaultarchive.com)

_Legal_

# Privacy Policy

Last updated September 3, 2026

This policy covers avenegtechnologies.com only — the corporate website you are reading now. It does not cover any software the Company publishes. Watch Vault Archive handles data differently, entirely on your own computer, and has its own, separate Privacy Policy at [watchvaultarchive.com/privacy](https://watchvaultarchive.com/privacy).

The short version: this site collects nothing about you automatically. No cookies, no analytics, no tracking scripts. If you never email us, we have no data about you at all.

## 1. What we collect from this site

Nothing, by design. This site is static — there are no accounts, no forms, no cookies, and no analytics or tracking scripts of any kind running on it.

Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, generates standard web server logs as an ordinary part of serving any website (for example, IP address and request timing, for security and reliability purposes). We do not access or analyze these logs as a matter of routine, and they are not used to build a profile of you.

## 2. If you email us

If you write to [info@avenegtechnologies.com](mailto:info@avenegtechnologies.com) or [legal@avenegtechnologies.com](mailto:legal@avenegtechnologies.com), we receive your email address and whatever you send. We use it only to respond to you. We do not add you to a mailing list, sell it, or share it with anyone, other than the infrastructure that delivers the email to us in the first place (see below).

## 3. Third parties

This site is hosted and its email is routed by Cloudflare, Inc., which operates the infrastructure that serves these pages and delivers mail sent to our addresses. Cloudflare’s own privacy policy governs its handling of data in that role.

## 4. Children

This site is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.

## 5. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page reflects the version currently in effect.

## 6. Contact

Questions about this policy: [legal@avenegtechnologies.com](mailto:legal@avenegtechnologies.com)
